name: 90808 · Long Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 90808 (Long Beach) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90808 (Long Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90808 (Long Beach) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).
